text_block_list.text:
So you have come, Doto, to the castle
that
crowns the sacred ground where my
love for
opera beats strongest—the
Takurazuka Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
You are Cinderella, waiting for her
dance at the
castle, her evil stepsisters
(the other racers) rife
with envy!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Will I, the lord of the castle, claim
victory? Will
the princess? Or perhaps...
those evil stepsisters?
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Now, the royal drama of the Takarazuka
Kinen
begins!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
